# PowerShell completion for jet (generated by `jet self completions powershell`)
$JetCommands = @('registry','inspect','bind','project','self','diff','merge','review','run','jobs','check','fill','test','test-compare','prove','status','build','cc','c++','dev','try','debug','crash','repl','import','new','fmt','fix','audit','lint','doc','explain','env','cache','remote','trust','image','os','add','remove','fetch','search','find','update','init','split','fold','gc','clean','emit','eval','budget','perf','version','help')
$JetFlags = @('--live','--observe','--log','--structural','--base-receipt','--receipt','--out','--repo','--json','--topic','--to','--list-topics','--kind','--quiet','--color','--version','--apply','--preview','--remove','--path','--route','--model','--check','--lang','--diff','--simplify','--changed','--explicit-copies','--skipped','--stdin-path','--output','--locked','--sha256','--effect','--example','--lock','--host','-p','--annotated','--force','--no-sign','--registry','--pkg','--before','--advisory-db','--vendor-dir','--sbom','--verbose','--template','--sort','--online','--fix','--dry-run','--keep','--edition','--all','--markers','--try-anyway','--caps','--watch','--port','--project','--no-prepare','-e','--pure','--allow','--allow-all','-A','--deny','--offline','--fixtures','--project-root','--build-root','-c','-o','-MMD','-MD','-MF','-MT','--sysroot','-I','-D','-L','-l','-std','-dumpmachine','-print-sysroot','-dumpversion','-v','--gate','--target','--up','--sql','--down','--risk','--no-color','--env','--preset','--explain-partition','--fresh','--docs','--filter','--capture','--update-snapshots','--shuffle','--serial','--measure','--trace-tiers','--time-limit','--opt-in','--shard','--list','--cases','--jobs','--memory','--allow-shrink','--diagnostic-coverage','--results','--compiler','--jetpack','--where','--grade','--iterations','--time','--seed','--corpus','--browser-retries','--browser-reporter','--browser-ui','--browser-visual','--browser-trace','--update','--coverage','--times','--ast','--ir','--fn','-u','--release','--profile','--optimize','-O0','-O1','-O2','--bounds','--debug-info','--small','--inline','--backtrace','--dead-code','--checked-alloc','--write-generated','--output-dir','--libs','--link-args','--os','--min-os','--action-timeout','--set','--threads','--trace','--builder','--a11y','--complexity','--max','--scope','--core','--show-default','--record','--lens','--facts','--annotations','--baseline','--bootstrap','--accept-regression','--reason','--yes','-y','--prelude','--style')
$JetGroups = @{ 'registry' = @('publish','yank','keygen','key','vendor'); 'inspect' = @('types','rights','claims','shapes','decisions','structure','build','gates','graph','query','explain-build','compiler','impact','provenance','digest','env','semindex','output','expand','schema','codemod','audit','bind','logs','info','outdated','reserved'); 'project' = @('parts'); 'self' = @('toolchain','doctor','completions','man','devtools','lsp'); 'env' = @('test','hook','sync','info','fetch-toolchain'); 'cache' = @('status','prune','limit'); 'os' = @('bridge','services','config'); 'gc' = @('report'); 'perf' = @('run','test','attach','view','compare','export') }
$JetJobs = @((& jet --json jobs 2>$null | ConvertFrom-Json).jobs.name)
Register-ArgumentCompleter -Native -CommandName jet -ScriptBlock {
param($wordToComplete,$commandAst,$cursorPosition)
$words = @($commandAst.CommandElements | ForEach-Object { $_.Extent.Text })
$choices = if ($wordToComplete.StartsWith('-')) {
$JetFlags
} elseif ($words.Count -ge 2 -and $JetGroups.ContainsKey($words[1])) {
$JetGroups[$words[1]]
} else {
$JetCommands + $JetJobs
}
$choices | Where-Object { $_ -like "$wordToComplete*" } |
ForEach-Object { [System.Management.Automation.CompletionResult]::new($_,$_,"ParameterValue",$_) }
}
